'''Viis''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located within the [[Viis system/Legends|Viis system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. It was home to the [[Viis Empire]]. It was decimated by a prolonged outbreak of [[Mnggal-Mnggal]].<ref name="The Unknown Regions">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
